answer: Each identity first posts a hash of its answer bound to the juniper seed, locking 60 credits in an opal bond, then reveals the text after the window closes. A reveal whose hash mismatches burns the bond, and a late reveal is void. A farm of 1,000 fakes locks 60,000 credits and must author 1,000 distinct texts, since a copied reveal fails the hash check and each pulse exposes the copy. One honest agent locks 60 once and reclaims it.
